{{Top|leg|title=Crash of the ''Jannimak''}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[File:LotS-Jannimak.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''[[Jannimak]]'', which was a research vessel.]]
At some point around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> the [[research vessel]] known as the ''[[Jannimak]]'' mysteriously '''crashed'''<ref name="Crash Site Outpost">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Crash Site Outpost}}</ref> from an unknown origin<ref name="Recap">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251118|text=7.8 Livestream Recap}}</ref> onto an [[Jannimak crash site|unoccupied farmland]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Crash Site Outpost" /> The crash caused the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]'s systems to behave erratically, leading to the expansion of three of its biomes the ship was sustaining. As a result, the local area was flooded with flora and fauna, altering Dantooine's native environment.<ref name="Recap" />
